name: Gratecrawler
name_status: Proposed working name, not user-approved canon
description: A hunched sludge creature with porcelain teeth and a rusty drain strainer embedded in its back; it climbs through warned floor grates.
implementation_status: Integrated in Prototype 57 / 0.57.0: floor-only patrol with boundary and obstacle turns; no jumping or pursuit. Headless and packaged checks pass; live visual review pending.

health.rationale: Uses approved trial HP tier; validates pressure and emergence without retuning full level.
health.comparison_note: Full damage/no armor/all hits land. Misses add shots; windup and range reduce practical DPS. Single-target comparisons do not count area collateral. Trial overrides apply only to starter weapons.

marketing.status: pending; no hyperrealistic portrait generated for provisional design

runtime_support_note: Canonical combat-data schema uses HUD preview only because its damage-state atlas is pending; the separate opening-role system implements Prototype 57 floor patrol.

active_level_profile.note: Prototype 57 floor-only patrol; active opening profile supplies HP and starter-weapon comparisons.
